desc: a host who drops exactly at a gate after earlier drops (fix-021, 19.6.7 'At a barrier'): a hosts in stag0101 with b, both walk to matz02 and stand by it; from @230 the proxy holds a's packets for 7 s at a time, 0.2 s apart, eight times (W7g's cuts: an absence debt of about 45 s), then both step on matz02 at @292 and a's own client cuts its link at its park for 40 s (DW4_ONLINE_TEST_CUT_AT_PARK). b's link is 150 ms slower upward, so a's BARRIER comes first and the barrier is still gathering when a's link closes: it is decided without him and b goes on into stag0102 at once. a shares no stage group with b, so his grace is a fresh 60 s; back after 40 s he arrives alone and joins b, still host. Before, the gathering stage group counted as shared with b: the debt left the grace about 25 s and the instance ended (host_lost) before a came back (k10 for both: the route crosses stag0101's rock slope)
